response.overview: When a family inheritance comes with an unusual condition, six estranged cousins are brought together for an unforgettable journey into the mountains of Uttarakhand.  Following the final wish of their late grandfather, they must travel together to the mysterious Devshila Temple to fulfil a promise connected to their family's past. What begins as a journey driven by inheritance gradually turns into an emotional adventure filled with unexpected encounters, family conflicts, forgotten memories and hidden truths.  As they travel through the breathtaking Himalayan landscape, the cousins discover that the journey is about much more than an inheritance. It becomes a test of faith, relationships and the bonds that hold a family together.  DEVSHILA is a cinematic family adventure woven with mystery, devotion, emotions and the divine presence of Lord Mahadev.
response.title: Devshila
